citation.authors: Mishra SS, Stoklosinski H, Hedderley D, Dinnan H, Martell S, McKenzie M, Monro J
citation.title: Effect of Lamb and Soy Protein on Postprandial Glycaemic, Insulin and Appetite Responses to Potato, Pasta and Rice in Macronutrient-Equalised Meals—A Randomised Pilot Human Intervention Study

population.description: Fifteen healthy volunteers, 8 men and 7 women (Table 2; 12 Caucasian, 2 Asian, 1 Persian), New Zealand; recruited aged 18-65 y (an enrolment criterion, not an observed range, so not entered as min/max); glucose intolerance excluded by history and a screening fasting blood glucose and HbA1c, plus pregnancy, vegan/vegetarian diet, antacids/laxatives/supplements and recent ill health. Table 2 prints age 42.4 ± 3.7 y and BMI 25.0 ± 1.2 kg/m2 with the ± not labelled SD or SE anywhere, so only the means are entered.

protocols.name: potato
protocols.description: Test meal 'Potato' (Table 1, meal composition): 44.1 g carbohydrate, 5.0 g protein, 12.8 g fat (1247 kJ) per Table 1B (the whole meal's composition; the 40 g of Methods 2.1.3 is the in vitro available carbohydrate each staple was portioned to give, not the meal total), eaten within 10 min from minute 0 after fasting from 22:00 the night before; seated; capillary samples to 150 min. Clock hour of the test and so the fast length are not printed. Meal details (Table 1A, Methods 2.1): cooked Potato 205 g, lamb fat 12.3 g, pasta sauce 44 g (Wattie's garlic-flavoured), water 146 g 'consumed separately with meal'; the fat is 'rendered lamb fat' added 'to each of the meals not containing lamb' (Methods 2.1.3 prints 12.6 g, Table 1A 12.3 g); no protein source is named for this meal, so protein_source is not entered; no fibre, sugars or fat types are printed.

left_out.what: insulin area (Table 3, 'Insulin (μU/mL.min)', mean and s.e. for each of the nine meals, n = 15): the minutes at which capillary insulin was sampled are not printed (the mixed model's 5 time df for iIR imply six insulin times against eight for glucose), and the table does not say whether the area is total or incremental (Figure 4 legend: 'insulin (AUC)'; Results: 'iIR')

amplitude (peak height) of the incremental glucose and insulin responses for each of the nine meals (Table 4, mean and s.e.): a per-person peak minus baseline, which no statistic expresses; the rice + lamb insulin s.e. is printed 65.8 beside a mean of 65.2
percentage increases in insulin response with added protein (Results: pasta, rice, potato with soy and lamb), derived from the insulin areas
incremental blood glucose at 60 min for potato, pasta and rice alone (Results, 2.16, 1.21, 1.45 mmol/L): only an LSD is printed, no uncertainty of each mean
glucose and insulin time courses for the nine meals (Figure 3) and the diet effect on incremental insulin (Figure 4)
screening fasting plasma glucose 4.4 ± 0.1 mmol/L (Table 2): ± not labelled SD or SE
appetite visual analogue scales (hunger, fullness, desire, quantity, composite) at 0, 60 and 150 min (Figures 5 and 6, Tables 5 and 6)
